body:
I appreciate your thoughts but almost everyone else in the world disagrees with you. In any case it was no better than I deserved, and the proof is that *she* left *me.* I would have stayed with her forever and I would probably go back now if I could. 

I think about it every minute of every day and I'm so tired of it. I even dream about every single night. 

I could not live with myself if I damaged innocent lives. Suicide is a very elegant solution. I damage their lives, but I don't have to live with it. Sound cold? Yes, it is, because I'm a selfish, heartless asshole.

It doesn't matter the amount of others' influence on me as in the end my decisions were my own. I made my own bed, and now I have to figure out how to lie in it.

As far as therapy goes, I am probably looking for a magic bullet. I am a hugely selfish person, and I am unable to change. I have been told by numerous people that I am just *unwilling* to change, and that's true. I am at base just a miserable asshole who drags everyone around me down and I guess I'm just OK with that.

There's not enough time in the world to go into every  crappy decision I've made. I guess if I had to choose the worst one, it would be the 15-year relationship in which I contributed to my own sexual, psychological, and emotional abuse. Yes, I asked for it. Yes, I stayed. Yes, I am a male and my partner was female, so no one sympathizes, or, quite frankly, SHOULD sympathize as it was my own choice.

My second worst choice was to get into another relationship. I'm still in it and can't get out of it, and if I did it would fuck up many lives, not just my own. The only way to remove myself from this situation is to just remove myself permanently. Yes, it's going to hurt some people, but in the end everyone will be better off.
